ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Service Installation Image Path
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects uncommon service installation commands by looking at suspicious or uncommon image path values containing references to encoded powershell commands, temporary paths, etc.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND ((ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\\\\.\\\\pipe.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ \\-e.*") AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ aQBlAHgA.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ aWV4I.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ IAB.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ JAB.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ PAA.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ SQBFAFgA.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ SUVYI.*")))) AND  NOT (ImagePath = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Definition\\ Updates\\\\")) AND  NOT (ImagePath = RGX("^C\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\TEMP\\\\thor10\\-remote\\\\thor64\\\.exe"))
